{"summary":"Task: routing, 5 nodes; return a permutation of nodes 1–4, starting at depot 0 at time 0, visiting each once, then returning to 0. Travel times are directed; waiting is forbidden; window bounds are inclusive. Check a time/window/budget only once all travel rows needed for it are revealed. Satisfy all revealed requirements, including earlier stages. Stage passes are provisional; there is no optimization objective. Candidate/checkpoint format: files and values empty; order contains route excluding depot.

Revealed travel rows (costs indexed by destination node 0–4): from 0 [0,9,7,1,9]; from 1 [7,0,5,3,2]; from 2 [6,1,0,5,3]; from 3 [5,5,8,0,3]; from 4 [2,8,5,1,0].

Windows: node 3 [0,2] (stage 2); node 2 [6,10], node 1 [7,13], node 4 [9,14] (stage 3). Stage 4 remains; 8 actions remain.

Supplied candidate and checkpoint both have order [3,4,2,1], files [], values []. Stage 1 receipt: public_pass, 3 checks. Stage 2 receipt: public_pass, 6 checks; checkpoint feedback: public_pass, 6 checks. These passes are provisional. Trial notes are unverified: stage 1 says the route permutation used only revealed travel rows; stage 2 says node 3 is visited at time 1 within its window. No wrong attempt is recorded."}
